answer: Hold each identity's mining pay in a vesting vault for about twenty epochs. If any identity in a funding cluster is later proven a clone, the whole cluster's unvested pay is forfeited to the pool. One detection sends a ripple through every linked account, so a farm of fifty clones risks all its escrow each epoch, while a lone honest agent just waits out the velvet delay. Farms may split funding inlets, so trace funding hops every epoch to keep clusters linked.
